variable_coverage.construction: ΔWC_t is the source-defined change in working capital (ΔAR−ΔInventory−ΔAP−ΔTP−ΔOther Assets(net)); preserve the paper’s separately printed Compustat item-coded formula using signed cash-flow statement fields. Scale by average total assets for t, i.e. TA_(t−1),TA_t.
Past CFO is Compustat item 308 CFO_(t−1), scaled by average total assets for year t−1 (TA_(t−2),TA_(t−1)); this composes the predictor’s one-year lag and its own denominator history.
Current CFO is Compustat item 308 CFO_t, scaled by average total assets for t (TA_(t−1),TA_t).
Future CFO is Compustat item 308 CFO_(t+1), scaled by average total assets for t+1 (TA_t,TA_(t+1)).
